description: Never again will you have to build a Ramp one step at a time. Take over the world efficiently, increase your productivity, and enjoy building diagonally with the new Double Ramps!

description: How did you even figure out how to get this? Whatever... You deserve it.

name: Golden Cart available in the AWESOME Shop
Half Foundation Set
description:
Are regular Foundations too wide for your needs? Want to keep space on your floor for Conveyor Lifts?
Introducing: Half Foundations! Half the size, full price!

name: Hypertube Wall Attachments
description: Never again will a wall stop you from swooping through your factory. With the new next-gen Hypertube Wall Hole included in this pack, speed has no limits!

name: Flood Lights
description: Specifically designed to illuminate outdoor areas, the Flood Lights are the perfect choice for lighting up construction sites or outposts. Their height makes them tower over even the largest of buildings. And for additional convenience, the Wall version can be placed on any Wall, which is ideal for indoor settings or if more precise light placement is required.

name: Clean Pipeline Mk.1
description: This clean version of the Mk.1 Pipeline does not feature the external fluid indicator, sacrificing feedback for style.

name: Clean Pipeline Mk.2
description: This clean version of the Mk.2 Pipeline does not feature the external fluid indicator, sacrificing feedback for style.

name: Quarter Pipe Extensions Pack
description: Bring your Quarter Pipes to new heights, or simply add rounded accents to your factory design, with the brand-new special Quarter Pipe Extensions.

name: FICSIT Roofs
description:
Every pioneer deserves a Roof over their head and factory. Get this basic human need now for only 6 Coupons!

Once Roofs are unlocked, Roof Materials will become available for purchase in the Customizer section of the AWESOME Shop. Do not miss out on these special looks!

name: FICSIT Roof Corners
description: New research has shown that repetitive Roof aesthetics reduce pioneer efficiency. Solve your productivity issues today with these versatile Roof Corner pieces!

name: Golden Nut
description: It's a Golden Nut. It's shiny and the price is totally justified. Don't overthink it, you need one! Purchase a Golden Nut today! (Warning: Ingestion not recommended).

name: Lizard Doggo
